title: Easy To Follow 30 Minute Dance Workout View From The Back (Salsa, Bachata, Merengue, Mambo And More)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor teaches in a high-energy dance workout style, facing away from the camera to make following along easier. She continuously calls out steps, counts, and gives encouragement while moving with her backup dancers.

lesson_structure.note: Amanda introduces the 30 minute dance workout and explains they will face away from the camera
Teaches Merengue marching, walking, and side steps
Transitions into Mambo basic steps and side steps
Teaches Cha Cha time steps and Cuban breaks

steps_taught.name: Merengue March
steps_taught.description: Marching in place starting with the left foot

steps_taught.name: Mambo Basic
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward and back with basic mambo rhythm

steps_taught.name: Cha Cha Time Step
steps_taught.description: Time steps and Cuban breaks for cha cha

what_works: Instructor faces away from the camera so students can mirror her movements directly
Consistent counting and clear verbal cues before transitions
what_hinders: Fast transitions between different dance styles without much pause

quotes.text: Today we are going to face away from you so it's easier to follow along.
All righty guys, our first dance is merengue.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands facing the camera introducing the workout in a studio.
Instructor and dancers turn around facing away from the camera, marching in place.

extraction.distinctive_method: Instructing entirely facing away from the camera for the duration of the workout to eliminate left-right confusion for viewers.
